title: Tropical Rainforest Loss Drops 36% in 2025, but Fires Threaten Global Progress
snippet: GFW/UMD GLAD Lab data released April 29, 2026 — World lost 4.3M ha tropical primary rainforest in 2025 (Denmark size); fires accounted for 42% of 25.5M ha total tree cover loss. Loss still 46% higher than a decade ago. El Niño risk for 2026 fires.
source_name: World Resources Institute / Global Forest Watch
tag_reason: First run; major April 29 GFW data release.

entities.name: 2025년 전 지구 열대 원시림 손실 4.3M ha (GFW/UMD 분석)
